description: Show one operation in full: method, path, plan, group, required scope, path parameters, summary, the source file it was derived from, and the exact makehybrid_read/makehybrid_write arguments that invoke it. Use this before calling an operation you have not called before.

ref.description: Reference to one operation: "plan:operation_id" (e.g. "complete:get_asana_v1_connections"), "plan:METHOD /path" (e.g. "complete:POST /complete/v2/{account_id}/posts"), or a bare operation id when it is unique across the enabled plans.

name: makehybrid_describe_operation
title: MakeHybrid: describe an operation
